notes: The full platform-behaviour audit pass, on both operating systems. Android: no screen renders under the status bar any more; the drawer switches sections the way Android apps do (no more stacking the same screen twice); chat state now survives rotating the phone mid-message; you can long-press-select finished answers and tap links inside them; read-aloud pauses your music properly instead of talking over it; if the microphone was permanently denied there is now an Open Settings way back; pull-to-refresh on Chats; a dead connection now shows honestly in chat; Dark/Light choice, text-size slider, haptics toggle and reduce-motion actually do what they say. iOS: the composer grows with your message and Return sends; the settings theme picker and text-size slider now really apply; assistant headings, sheets and buttons scale with your system text size; VoiceOver labels everywhere incl. the voice orb; links in replies are tappable and code blocks are selectable; the drawer tracks your finger with real fling physics; keyboards get a Done bar; Explore and Create get their back button; searches stopped blocking the interface. Same design, same features — each platform just behaves like itself now.
